🎬 The Rosa Parks Story (2002)

The Rosa Parks Story tells the inspiring true story of Rosa Parks, a courageous African American woman whose refusal to give up her seat on a segregated bus helped change the course of American history. Set during the Civil Rights Movement, the film explores Rosa’s childhood, marriage to Raymond Parks, and growing involvement in the fight against racial discrimination in Montgomery, Alabama. Despite facing injustice, humiliation, and constant obstacles, Rosa remains determined to stand up for equality and human dignity. On December 1, 1955, her decision to refuse a bus driver’s order to surrender her seat to a white passenger leads to her arrest and helps spark the historic Montgomery Bus Boycott. Starring Angela Bassett and Peter Francis James, the film delivers powerful performances and emotional storytelling while highlighting courage, sacrifice, resilience, and the extraordinary impact one person’s determination can have on the fight for justice and civil rights.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Drama • History

⭐ IMDb: 7.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 1h 37m • TV Movie

🎥 Director: Julie Dash

✍️ Writer: Paris Qualles

📚 Based On: The life of Rosa Parks and her historic role in the American Civil Rights Movement.

🏆 Awards: Angela Bassett received a Primetime Emmy Award nomination for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Miniseries or Movie.
